items.t: Nelson Peltz's Trian Pushes Solventum To Spin Off Health IT Unit Unless Buyers Pay Up
items.sum: Activist investor Nelson Peltz urges Solventum to spin off its Health Information Systems unit to avoid taxes and unlock share price upside.

items.t: Best Dividend Stocks to Buy for Dependable Dividend Growth
items.sum: How do you find the best dividend stocks to buy? Income investors know there's no substitute for regular dividend increases over the long haul.

items.t: 3M's Transportation and Electronics Unit Gains Momentum: What Lies Ahead?
items.sum: MMM's Transportation and Electronics segment benefits from strong semiconductor, aerospace and data center demand, while product innovation supports growth.

items.t: Dow Jones Top Gainers Today: NVDA, CAT, GOOGL Lead
items.sum: Dow Jones components NVDA, CAT, GOOGL, CSCO and GS were among today's top gainers, with NVIDIA up 31.37% and Caterpillar up 6.68%.

items.t: RTX, 3M and Illinois Tool Works Just Fell. Their Dividend Stories Are Still Growing
items.sum: Three industrial giants sank last week even as each raised guidance and boosted its payout. One carries a 63-year streak, another rebuilt after a painful cut, and a third sits on a record backlog. Which one deserves a retiree's cash?
